title: A Civics-oriented Approach to Understanding Intersectionally Marginalized Users’ Experience with Hate Speech Online
reasoning: The paper is a qualitative empirical study exploring how intersectional identities (specifically Indigenous ethnic minorities and women in Bangladesh) shape experiences with online hate speech. While it discusses religious identity as a factor in social marginalization and mentions freedom of religion as a civic right, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
